text.original_context: Printing and messages, a timeline. Around 1440, Johannes Gutenberg built a printing press with movable type in Mainz. About fifteen years later, around 1455, his workshop printed the Gutenberg Bible. Much later, in 1844, Samuel Morse sent a telegraph message from Washington to Baltimore. Alexander Graham Bell received his telephone patent in 1876.
text.original_input: Which came first, the telegraph or the telephone, and when did printing with movable type start?
